title: ATS Handling Audit
requirements: Audit Resources/Info.plist NSAppTransportSecurity: confirm the exception for api.openai.com is present and scoped (NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=false); verify no broader exceptions

Ensure WhisperClient maps a TLS-rejected / network-unavailable response to a clear typed error: extend WhisperClientError with a networkUnavailable case (or whisperError(0) with errorDescription "Network unavailable: transcription is offline")

Surface the TLS / network failure to the user via the same error-banner pathway defined in finish-recording-error-feedback (not a silent hang or restated empty error): show "Network unavailable: transcription failed"
Disconnect from the network and run the transcription flow end-to-end (manual verification acceptable); assert a clear toast / banner rather than a silent hang

Document the ATS exception for openai.com as a known risk in specs/decisions.md or CODE_REVIEW_ISSUES-equivalent note: OpenAI may rotate endpoints without notice; if they do, this exception must be updated
acceptance_criteria: Disconnecting the network and running transcription yields a clear "network unavailable" toast/banner, not a silent hang
A TLS-rejected connection reports whisperError(0) (or networkUnavailable) with an errorDescription
ATS exceptions in Info.plist are scoped to api.openai.com only; NSAllowsArbitraryLoads is false
